name: claude-builder
description: The /builder:* build pipeline — a dependency-free, project-agnostic Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: builder
plugins.description: Talks your idea through against the code, then builds it: small changes in the chat, bigger ones through a spec you approve, a plan and a build one app at a time. By default agents build, test and merge it locally, marked not human-tested; or test it yourself and sign off before any PR. Reads every project fact from .claude/builder.md. No dependencies.
